bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Warp Touched
bonuses.text: Whenever a Rogue Psyker rolls a Psychic Mastery (Wil) Test, they gain bonus Wrath dice equal to the Tier of the game.

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Rogue Psyker attempts to activate Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power (p.280).

abilities.name: Psychic Storm
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Rogue Psyker attempts to activate a psychic power or Deny the Witch (p.267).

options.name: Your Rogue Psyker
options.text: A Rogue Psyker could focus on any of the Disciplines presented in Chapter 12 — use whatever best fits your sorcerer. You might also like to add the following ability to turn a Rogue Psyker into a potential recurring Threat (p.339).

abilities.name: Daemonic Possession
abilities.text: When this Threat exceeds its Maximum Wounds, roll a Wrath Die. If you roll a Complication, a daemon possesses the Threat, turning it into a Possessed Mortal that has suffered 5 Wounds.
